{{Quote|I got through to the base while you were getting set up. The rest of Rogue Squadron's on the way, along with every starfighter the base can scramble.|Wedge Antilles to Lando Calrissian, after an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer penetrated the Morishim system|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
A '''starfighter base''' used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]].

==Description==
The base had pyramidal launch towers and berthed three [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]] and two wings of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]].

==History==
The base was built by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] some times after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces evacuated the planet.

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was temporarily transferred to this base during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Bel Iblis's]] mission in the system. He visited the base for a summit with planetary leaders; it was during this meeting that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] [[Mission to Morishim|attempted to contact]] Bel Iblis with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] offer of surrender.
